title: Lead Software Engineer (Level 5) | BackEnd (Gurugram based)
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About the Team**



At Agoda, our Backend Engineering organization builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. Our systems span mission\-critical domains including **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



We operate with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, leveraging technologies like **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, supported by strong practices in **CI/CD, automation, and observability,** and **engineering excellence.**



We ship fast — with **dozens of daily releases** — and design systems that are **resilient, scalable, and continuously evolving.**

  


**The Opportunity**  

As a **Lead Backend Engineer**, you will **own critical systems end\-to\-end**, drive technical direction, and lead large initiatives. You will combine **architecture, execution, and technical leadership** to build scalable, reliable, and high\-quality solutions that power Agoda's global platform. You will **influence engineering decisions** beyond your immediate team, mentor engineers, shape development practices, and help raise the organization's technical bar.

  

**What You'll Do**



* Lead the architecture, design, and development of complex distributed systems at scale.
* Own the technical direction, delivery, and evolution of critical systems and platforms.
* Drive system design, API standards, software architecture, and engineering best practices across teams.
* Lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple services, teams, and stakeholders.
* Make key technical decisions, balancing business priorities with scalability, reliability, and maintainability goals.
* **Remain an active contributor to production systems through regular coding, code reviews, system design, and technical problem\-solving, balancing hands\-on execution with leadership responsibilities.**
* Mentor and coach engineers, helping raise technical capability, code quality, and engineering standards.
* Drive continuous improvements in development processes, engineering effectiveness, and agile ways of working.
* Align stakeholders and drive execution across cross\-functional teams.
* Lead production stability, incident management, root\-cause analysis, and long\-term reliability improvements.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve products, platforms, developer productivity, and customer experience

  


  

**What We're Looking For**


* 11\+ Years experience building and operating large\-scale backend systems in production environments.
* Proven experience delivering complex distributed systems at scale.
* Strong expertise in Java, Scala, Kotlin, or Go.
* Strong software architecture skills with a track record of driving architectural decisions within and across teams.
* Proven experience leading technical initiatives, projects, or engineering teams with end\-to\-end ownership.
* Recent and ongoing hands\-on coding experience in production environments is required.

Deep expertise in:


* Distributed systems and architecture
* API design and microservices
* Performance, scalability, and system reliability
* System design for high\-throughput, highly available applications

Nice to Have


* Experience building or owning large\-scale platforms across multiple services or domains.
* Experience designing and operating event\-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka.
* Experience with cloud\-native architectures on AWS or GCP.Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience driving cross\-team technical initiatives, platform modernization, or large\-scale migrations.
* Familiarity with high\-volume data systems, Spark, Hadoop, or related data platform technologies.
* Experience working in global product organizations with distributed engineering teams.

###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#kolkata \#coimbatore**

#### 


#### **Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click** **here****to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.**

  


### **Discover more about working at Agoda**


* Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
* Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
* LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
* YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.



We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.


**Disclaimer**



We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency's representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third\-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

title: Product Engineer
description:
### **Job Information**


* Department Name PRODUCT ENGINEERING
* Date Opened 09/24/2026
* Department Product Engineering
* Job Type Permanent
* Industry Software Development
* Required Skills
	+ RESTful Web APIs
	+ AWS cloud infrastructure
	+ \+21
* City Coimbatore South
* State/Province Tamil Nadu
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 641035
### **About Us**


MaxVal started as an IP services company in 2004, with a keen focus on efficiency, cost\-effectiveness, and continuous improvement through metric\-based processes. Our focus on these core values led to the tech\-enablement of our offerings even before this buzzword became an industry standard. Over the years, MaxVal developed many internal applications to increase our quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. As these systems grew and became more sophisticated, we have productized them and offered them to our clients. Today, MaxVal serves over 650 clients across the full IP life cycle with the industry's leading products and services. our 730 plus employees represent the most IP and tech\-savvy individuals in the industry. At MaxVal, we do the right things and innovate ceaselessly as a winning team to achieve customer success and employee success.  

  

### **Job Description**


### **Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain high\-availability enterprise web applications. You will build modern frontend interfaces using Angular 17\+, implement RESTful ASP.NET Core Web APIs, manage data architectures on MS SQL Server/PostGre SQL, and deploy services across AWS cloud infrastructure.  

  



  

  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Frontend Development:** Build high\-performance, reactive single\-page applications (SPAs) using Angular 17\+ featuring Signals, standalone components, dynamic routing, and RxJS.
* **Web API \& Backend:** Design, secure, and maintain RESTful Web APIs and microservices using C\# and .NET Core / .NET 8\+. Implement JWT authentication, CORS policies, rate limiting, and Entity Framework Core.
* **Database Engineering:** Write optimized T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and index structures in MS SQL Server. Conduct query performance tuning and execution plan analysis.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Provision, deploy, and monitor APIs and web assets on AWS. Maintain automated CI/CD pipelines.
* **Software Quality \& Security (Optional):** Write unit and integration tests (xUnit/NUnit for APIs, Jasmine/Karma for Angular). Enforce Web API security best practices (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, OWASP standards).

  

  

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **Frontend:** 2\+ years with Angular (with hands\-on experience in Angular 17 or higher, TypeScript, and modern state management).
* **Backend \& APIs:** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing RESTful ASP.NET Core Web APIs using C\#, .NET Core / .NET 8, and Entity Framework Core.
* **Database:** Strong proficiency in MS SQL Server, database design, T\-SQL scripting, and query optimization.
* **AWS Cloud:** Working experience with AWS core services
* **Tools \& Protocols:** Solid understanding of API documentation tools (Swagger/OpenAPI), Git, Docker, and CI/CD tools (AWS CodePipeline, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions)

title: Python/Django Developer
description:
Job Description – Python Full Stack Developer (1–3 Years Experience)

**Position:** Python Full Stack Developer  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Location:** Coimbatore

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Python Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have experience in both front\-end and back\-end development, with strong knowledge of Python frameworks and modern web technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain web applications using Python and modern front\-end technologies.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly UI components.
* Integrate front\-end applications with backend systems and databases.
* Write clean, efficient, and reusable code.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Participate in code reviews and follow best development practices.

Required SkillsBackend

* Strong knowledge of **Python**
* Experience with **Django, Flask, or FastAPI**
* REST API development and integration
* Database management using **MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB**

Frontend

* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
* Experience with **React.js, Angular, or Vue.js**
* Responsive web design and UI development

Tools \& Technologies

* Git/GitHub
* Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts
* Knowledge of AWS or cloud platforms is an added advantage
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Docker and containerization.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with authentication and security best practices.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹27,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
